name: 030-voice-clone-base
description: Synthesize a known short utterance via the Qwen3-TTS Base voice. Reference output is an expected token count range (not byte-exact audio) because the audio codec is non-deterministic in the bit-domain even when the symbol stream is identical.

request_body.input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

ref_outputs.notes: We do not byte-compare audio: the codec is permitted to introduce non-determinism in PCM least-significant bits across runs / hardware. Comparison strategy: (1) WAV header sanity (`crate::oapi::audio_speech::write_wav_header` shape); (2) duration in [1.5s, 5.5s] for the given utterance + speed=1.0; (3) approximate token-count range derived from the BPE tokenizer at 12 Hz frame rate (see `nv_tts::tokenizer`). Real-model T5 tolerance from §10.1 applies once weights are loaded.
